base_dir.description: Absolute path to the root working directory for job spools, metadata, and logs.

listen_addr.description: Network interface address to bind the server socket to (ignored in single mode).

port.description: TCP port for incoming client and peer connections.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads per job queue slot to process incoming jobs concurrently.

max_queue_depth.description: Maximum number of jobs that may be queued before blocking new job submissions.

job_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds a job may remain in 'running' state before being marked as failed and requeued.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (use '-' to log to stdout).

enable_tls.description: Enable mutual TLS authentication for inter-node and client communication.

tls_cert_file.description: Absolute path to the server certificate chain file (required if TLS enabled).

tls_key_file.description: Absolute path to the server private key file (required if TLS enabled).

tls_ca_file.description: Optional absolute path to the CA certificate for verifying peers.

tls_server_name.description: Optional server name for TLS verification (overrides peer hostname check).

peers.description: List of peer nodes in a distributed cluster. Each peer defines host and port.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the peer node.

port.description: TCP port of the peer node (must match its 'port' setting).

queues.description: Job queue configurations. Each queue defines its behavior, retry policy, and optional DLQ.

name.description: Unique name of the job queue.

retry_limit.description: Maximum number of immediate retries after a transient failure.

max_retries_before_dlq.description: Number of total retries after which a job is moved to the dead-letter queue.

dead_letter_queue.description: Optional name of the queue to which permanently failed jobs are moved.
